pages.title: Skin Replacement
pages.text: DragIt lets you replace your character's skin by dragging a local image file into the Minecraft window — no need to upload to a Mojang account.$(br2)The change takes effect immediately on the client, and other players on the same server will also see your new skin (subject to server sync permissions).

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: $(bold)1.$() Open your inventory (default key $(key)E$()).$(br2)$(bold)2.$() While the inventory screen is open, drag a $(bold).png$() skin file from your file explorer into the game window.$(br2)$(bold)3.$() Release the file — your skin updates instantly.$(br2)$(note)The inventory (or any EffectRenderingInventoryScreen) must be open. Dropping while in-game with no screen open will not trigger skin replacement.$()

pages.title: File Size Limit
pages.text: $(warn)Skin files must be 128×128 pixels or smaller.$()$(br2)Files exceeding this size will be rejected and a warning message will appear in chat.$(br2)$(note)Standard Minecraft skin dimensions are 64×64 px (new format with outer layer) or 64×32 px (legacy format). Using standard dimensions is recommended for best compatibility.$()

pages.title: Server Sync
pages.text: When a skin is dropped, the raw image bytes are sent to the server via a network packet. The server then:$(br2)• Stores the skin data in the world's $(bold)DragItSavedSkins$() save file$(br)• Broadcasts the skin to all other online players$(br)• Re-sends the skin to any player who joins later$(br2)$(note)If your UUID is on the server blacklist, your skin will not be synced to other players.$()
